children: The SOON Foundation has temporarily suspended the cross-chain bridge between svmBNB and the SOON mainnet after abnormal withdrawal activity on October 31, 2026. According to ChainCatcher, the activity occurred at approximately 11:00 UTC, and the foundation detected it at 14:00 UTC that day and immediately shut down the bridge.
The foundation said it has brought the bridge under control and is conducting an investigation. The suspension will remain in place during the investigation, with further updates to be announced.
svmBNB uses SVM as its execution layer and BNB Chain as its settlement layer, while the SOON mainnet is a rollup network based on decoupled SVM.

title: SOON Foundation Pauses svmBNB–SOON Mainnet Cross-Chain Bridge
